EVT-0141.agent_script_text: Namaskar sir, hum aapko ek important payment reminder ke liye call kar rahe hain. Aapka ₹1,98,502 ka invoice abhi 68 days overdue hai. Kripya is overdue amount ka payment jaldi se jaldi clear kar dein. Thank you for your cooperation.
EVT-0141.customer_response_text: Aapka message mil gaya hai, main is mahine ke ant tak yeh saara payment clear karne ki koshish karta hoon.
